convertibility_reason: Uses external custom signal library ACBC_WS_CCI.mqh with custom indicator class CBC_WS_CCI. Trading logic is encapsulated in the custom signal filter, not directly in the EA body, requiring analysis of the external .mqh to extract full entry/exit rules.

other_exits: Signal-based close when CBC_WS_CCI signal strength drops below Signal_ThresholdClose (20)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MoneyFixedLot uses fixed lot size; Percent parameter (10.0) is for margin/freemargin calculation within the fixed-lot money manager

custom_logic_notes: The EA delegates all trading signal generation to the custom CBC_WS_CCI filter class from ACBC_WS_CCI.mqh. The signal uses a weighted threshold system: open threshold=40, close threshold=20. The filter weight is 1.0. Entry/exit direction logic is encapsulated in CBC_WS_CCI::LongCondition() and CBC_WS_CCI::ShortCondition() methods which are not visible in this file. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar, not every tick. Pending order expiration is set to 4 bars. No SL/TP are set directly — exits rely on signal reversal.
python_conversion_notes: The core CCI+MA crossover logic is inside ACBC_WS_CCI.mqh and must be read before Python conversion can proceed. The Standard Library CExpertSignal framework uses a threshold-weighted voting system — in Python, replicate by computing a raw signal score from CCI vs its MA, mapping to a [0..100] scale, then comparing against ThresholdOpen/ThresholdClose. No SL/TP means exits are purely signal-driven. New-bar gating is critical (EveryTick=false). Position sizing is trivial (fixed 0.1 lot).
